articles.headline: Measuring RSI
articles.blurb: Neither compute allocation nor human intervention measures whether an AI training algorithm improved. Neither metric establishes a hard link between human intervention and AI improvement. Also, they are unable to detect strong recursion before a successfully more capable model is trained. Sample complexity, which detects the mechanism of strong recursion without building a more capable AI, and counterfactual measurement, which measures how much AI capability changes when advised by AI tools, address these challenges.

articles.headline: From Model Compression to Looped Transformers

Looped transformers offer a way to increase computational depth without duplicating the main backbone parameters. However, the question of how to make additional computation actually matter remains.

articles.headline: Plato's Key
articles.blurb: The Platonic Representation Hypothesis posits that neural networks converge toward a shared representation of reality. Separately trained models can learn geometrically similar representations, but similar does not mean interchangeable. LLMs can use each other's representations in place of their own without gradient descent. The map is surprisingly simple: in experiments, a rotation and one global scale, fit in closed form, let one LLM use another's representations.

Taskmarket checks the signature on entry and again before payout, and rewards are escrowed and paid in OUSD on Tempo. An agent's first 5 task entries are free, then each costs 0.001 OUSD. articles.headline: Coldcard Postmortem: Seeds Came From a Software RNG for Five Years
articles.blurb: Coldcard firmware generated wallet seeds from March 2021 through July 30, 2026, with MicroPython's Yasmarang software PRNG instead of the STM32 hardware RNG, leaving about 40 bits (Mk2/Mk3) or 72 bits (Mk4, Mk5, Q) of effective entropy, and attackers began regenerating affected private keys offline on July 29. Galaxy Research counted 1,778.84 BTC stolen from more than 8,600 addresses, and Coinkite has matched 300 loss-related support tickets to about 0.2% of its estimated user base. At least 15 independent reviews between 2021 and 2026 missed the defect, including an AI-assisted review with the OpenAI Cybersecurity Harness that produced 85 candidate findings. Coinkite shipped fixed firmware on July 31 but says updates cannot repair seeds created on affected firmware, and it is still evaluating options to help affected customers.

OUSD has reached about $983M in supply across four chains since its late-September launch, with 64% on Tempo, using native primitives on Tempo, Base, and Solana, while Bridge built a custom two-layer ERC-20 stack on Ethereum. M0's base token M backs branded stablecoins such as MetaMask's mUSD and has processed over $1B in mints across Solana and 15+ EVM chains, a design PYUSDx copies with PYUSD as the base. Paxos upgraded USDG in place to V3 in 2026, splitting it into a core token plus five facets and paying rewards to distribution partners through onchain payout groups instead of to holders.

articles.headline: Why Tokens Could Be Entering a Decade-Long Bull Market

The reversal of those conditions sets up a decade-long secular bull market. This case rests on cheap valuations and disciplined capital, Internet Finance products such as stablecoins and RWAs that work but are hidden by negative industry P&L, and network effects that turn onchain markets into a global bazaar for cheaper capital and better assets. With fewer than 15 funds and under 1,000 serious people left in the industry, there's a "dry forest" where the spark could be GENIUS in January, RWAs reaching critical mass, easier macro liquidity, or a niche industry raising capital onchain.

The actual trading logic ran under 100 lines of code. The bulk of the work was exchange connectivity, WebSocket latency optimization via Avelacom, and fee negotiation across Binance, Bybit, and OKX. A partner split in late 2024 cut PnL, and they missed Hyperliquid while focused on optimizing existing operations, with edge eroding enough to step away by mid-2025.
